waves.rationale: integration layer 0: no upstream; no real collision among the six (no shared path); 005-01 builds from its own C1, the rest from sprint/S-03; the Developer commits of 001-10 and 002-09 seed C4/C5 for 003-10

integration layer 1: 003-10 (upstream 001-10, 002-09; real collisions on the package files and the enforce/SETUP.md/red-test lines, so it builds from C5); 005-02 (upstream 005-01; builds from its own C2); 005-06 (upstream 004-07, 005-01; builds from its own C3); 005-07 (upstream 003-12; builds from sprint/S-03). No real collision among them: src/program.ts gets one import + one defaultCommands entry each from 003-10, 005-02 and 005-06 (insert-only, keep every line). parallel_eligible n on 005-02 is a hint; the predicate finds no collision in this layer

integration layer 2: 003-11 builds from C6 (on top of 003-10's src/read/index.ts, read tests, SOURCES.md and lockfile); 005-03 builds from C7 (extends 005-02's lint tests); 005-04 and 005-08 build from C2; 005-05 builds from C3. src/lint/checks.ts: 005-03, 005-04 and 005-08 insert at their own C2 insertion points (insert-only, no real collision); 005-05 is this layer's only program.ts editor. The unreachable_surface paths of 003-11, 005-03, 005-04 and 005-08 are created by an upstream and carried in C6, C7 and C2, so they are ordering edges, not refusals

integration layer 3: upstream 005-05 (L2), 005-02, 005-06, 003-10, 002-09 (+ 001-10 via the C6 stack); builds from C6 (rule arrays, SETUP.md rows, enforce/setup red tests and rule-match.test.ts on top of 003-10 and 002-09; real collisions, ordered edits); re-syncs on sprint/S-03 after 005-02/005-05/005-06 merge so the real-tree template test sees lint, status and rules registered (decision 17)

integration layer 4: upstream 005-09 (L3), 005-04 (L2) and the rest; builds from C2 (consumes RULE_CHECKS, parseInstructions); its SETUP.md prose (step 3, step-4 bullets) and 005-09's step-4 table rows are separate hunks; re-syncs before QA-Verify
integration layer 5: upstream 006-10 (L4); builds from C8 (on top of 006-10's WIKI.md, SETUP.md and sub-agent prompt text and its shared red-test re-scopes; real collision, ordered edits)

integration layer 6: upstream 006-12 (L5), 006-10, 005-09 and every command story; builds from C9 (WIKI.md, SETUP.md, wiki-ingest SKILL.md, and wiki-protocol.red lines next to 006-10's, all on top; real collision, ordered edits); its two setup.red.node.test.ts lines are re-applied at integration on top of 003-10/005-09
